verdict.rationale: Mastra documents running agents and workflows without its Studio UI, either bundled into Node.js apps or as standalone server endpoints. It also offers built-in deployers that automate deployment and repeatable scoring checks before changes reach production, which suggests a pipeline-friendly design. However, no evidence explicitly documents a headless CLI mode or CI integration (e.g., running evals or agents in a CI job). Missing for 10: explicit headless/non-interactive run mode docs, documented CI integration or examples, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: Mastra bundles agents and workflows directly into existing React, Next.js and Node.js apps, or ships them as standalone endpoints.
Register agents and workflows on one Mastra server, run it locally, and deploy the same app to Mastra Cloud.
Mastra includes optional built-in deployers for Vercel, Netlify and Cloudflare to automate the deployment process.
Score agent runs against repeatable checks before changes reach production.
